messages:
sara-seo: Quick pre-launch check — can we do a targeted redirect + schema sweep for the webinar landing and benchmark article? Need canonical mapping, internal linking anchors, & JSON-LD for Event + Article. cc @liam-growth @marta-ops :eyes:

liam-growth: Yup. Can we get a CSV of current URLs -> desired URLs? I'll run the redirect simulation.

marta-ops: I can run the redirect audit on staging tomorrow AM. What SLIs? 302->301, preserve UTM params, and no redirect chains? :white_check_mark:

alex-prod-marketing: Draft mapping attached (excerpt):
old_url, new_url, redirect_type
/old-webinar, /product/webinar-2026, 301
/old-bench, /blog/2026-benchmark-latency, 301

Also we should add article schema snippet. Here's a suggested JSON-LD for the webinar event:
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference: Benchmarking Inference Economics",
  "startDate": "2026-04-15T14:00:00-07:00",
  "location": {"@type": "VirtualLocation","url": "https://redwood.ai/webinar-2026"},
  "organizer": {"@type": "Organization","name": "Redwood Inference"}
}
```

jin: For internal linking, let's create 3 anchor targets on product, blog, and docs pages. Anchor text: "benchmark results", "low-latency inference", "cost controls". I'll add to CMS.

marta-ops: regex for nginx redirects I used last time — drop into ops runbook:
```nginx
rewrite ^/old-webinar$ /product/webinar-2026 permanent;
rewrite ^/old-bench$ /blog/2026-benchmark-latency permanent;
```

sara-seo: Nice. Two asks: (1) Liam or Marta — run a crawl after staging deploy and prod deploy and post the redirect report here. (2) Alex — add the JSON-LD + meta canonical to the new pages before publish. Can anyone take item ownership?

liam-growth: I'll own the crawl + report. Will post CSV of 301s, chains, and any soft-404s.

alex-prod-marketing: I'll add JSON-LD + canonical meta in the CMS and flag for review.

jin: I'll push the anchor updates and a quick internal-linking map (Sitemap section: anchor -> target) and drop link to Google Doc here.

dev-rel-bot: Deployment scheduled: staging: 2026-04-07T09:00Z, prod: 2026-04-09T02:00Z :robot_face:

sara-seo: Perfect. Let's reconvene after Liam's crawl. Thanks all :pray:
